artworks.title: Successful Monster
artworks.dimensions:
plate: 30 x 20.2 cm (11 13/16 x 7 15/16 in.)
sheet: 41 x 29.2 cm (16 1/8 x 11 1/2 in.)
overall (mat size): 40.6 x 55.9 cm (16 x 22 in.)
artworks.description: The artwork shows two figures in a dynamic and intertwined position, depicting their full bodies. One figure appears muscular, kneeling with their left arm raised and covered by an animal's pelt, while the other stands close beside them. The kneeling figure has rugged facial features and is partially draped in fabric with foliage-like decorations. The standing figure has more delicate features, flowing hair, and a cloth draped over their shoulder and torso, leaving one leg mostly unclothed. The standing figure is slightly bent towards the other, with one arm raised above the head, and the other around the neck of the kneeling individual. A serpent wraps around the legs of both figures, extending its body across the ground. The background features lush foliage and reeds, with sketchy clouds, creating a mythological or pastoral setting. On the ground near the figures are small broken objects that appear to be a mask and a shield.

artworks.title: Enrag'd Monster
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a mythical sea creature. It has a humanoid face with exaggerated features and hair merging into fish-like scales and fins. The creature has a sinuous body and appears to be rising from the water. Its expression is fierce. The background features clouds and a hint of the sea, drawn in soft ink.

artworks.title: Musical Monster
artworks.description: The image shows two figures with most of their bodies visible. The figure on the right is reclined, playing a pan flute. The other figure is resting with their head on their arms, appearing to be asleep. The figure on the right has thick, curly hair adorned with leaves and flowers and strong facial features. The other figure has short hair and prominent facial features, partially turned away. Both figures appear unclothed, with muscular upper bodies visible. They are surrounded by dense vegetation and rocks. A large tail-like appendage extends from the resting figure, curling around the area. The background shows stylized clouds and a hint of water, with some animal bones or remains on the ground near the sleeping figure.

artworks.title: Comedy
artworks.description: The image shows a woman reading a book titled "NATURE" to two children. The woman is standing with one leg forward, holding the book open with one hand and gesturing at a page with the other hand. The children are sitting at her feet, one holding a mirror and the other leaning on a stick. In the background, there are lush trees with detailed leaves, and the sky is partly cloudy. The publication date of the image is December 8, 1779, and the title "COMEDY" is inscribed at the bottom.

artworks.title: Elegy
artworks.description: The image depicts two figures. One figure is reclining on a rocky surface, while the other is partially submerged in water. The reclining figure has flowing hair and is wearing a long, flowing garment with billowing sleeves. The other figure in the water also has long hair. There are no visible jewelry or objects being held by either figure. The background shows a rocky environment with swirling lines indicating movement. The artwork is rendered in a monochrome, illustrative style.

artworks.title: Tragedy
artworks.description: The image shows a person standing next to a large, round object. The person has long hair, is dressed in a robe with a sash, and is holding a bowl. There is also a decorative urn or vase nearby. The background shows swirling clouds and lines.

artworks.title: Reposo
artworks.description: The image shows a seated person leaning against a tree, with one leg bent and the other stretched out. The person's hand is under their chin in a thoughtful pose. They have a beard and are wearing a turban. The individual is dressed in loose-fitting clothing with rolled-up sleeves and appears to be barefoot. The background features foliage with branches and leaves, creating a natural setting. The sky is visible with clouds, contributing to the outdoor atmosphere.

artworks.title: Salvator Rosa
artworks.description: The image shows a male figure seated on a rocky surface, facing sideways with one arm extended holding a sheet of paper. He has sharp facial features with a prominent nose, thick beard, and curly hair flowing down his shoulders. He wears a long garment that wraps around his body and across his shoulder. At his feet is a helmet. The background features trees and foliage, creating a natural setting. The artwork is monochromatic, composed of fine lines and shading.

artworks.title: Banditti Taking His Post
artworks.description: The image shows a group of men. One man is seated on a rock, holding a spear in his left hand and appears to be talking with two other men in the scene. The seated man wears a helmet with a plume, chainmail tunic, shorts with a decorative pattern, and sandals. His long hair extends down his back. One man wears a turban and looks focused, while the other leans forward behind a rock. The background features trees, a cloudy sky, and rocks framing the group, and a large jug is in the foreground next to the seated man.

artworks.title: A Captn of Banditti Sending Out a Party
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a group preparing for action. The drawing shows a figure in elaborate, historical attire with a hat, plume, and a belt with weapons giving directions to another figure clad in armor, who is captured mid-motion. Another figure wearing a turban is leaning on a fence between them. Detailed line work adds depth to the sky and ground, suggesting an outdoor atmosphere with plants and a clear horizon. The composition focuses on the interaction and tension among the figures, emphasizing a possible narrative of organization and movement.

artworks.title: Banditti on the Look Out
artworks.description: Two men are depicted standing closely together in a rocky and natural setting. The man on the left leans against a stone structure, one arm resting on it, while his other hand reaches across his body to grasp the hilt of a sheathed sword. He has thick, curly hair, a beard, a prominent nose, and an intense expression. He wears a loose garment. The man on the right leans on the left man's shoulder. He wears a large hat with a feather, a ruffled shirt, and fitted breeches. One of his hands holds a sword vertically. The background shows hills beneath a cloudy sky, with leafy vegetation surrounding the pair.

artworks.title: Gerard Lairesse
artworks.description: The image shows a bearded man walking with a stick. His facial features are hidden by the beard, and his head is down. He has long curly hair, is wearing flowing garments, and his feet are visible. In the background, there is a canvas with a male figure and a female head, along with art tools. Surrounding him are rocks, vegetation, and a tree.

artworks.title: Studies of a Male Torso
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink on gray-blue paper
artworks.description: The image shows a drawing of a detailed study of the upper body, focusing on the torso from the neck to the waist. The torso is depicted in a slightly tilted position, indicating a muscular build with emphasis on the abdominal and pectoral muscles. There are no limbs or head in the drawing. The image is made with dark ink on a textured, light background. Handwritten text in a script is visible on the lower part of the image. The background is a plain surface.

artworks.title: Ritual Washing of the Israelites
artworks.medium: black chalk and pale blue-green wash on laid paper
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a group of figures performing various activities related to washing, drying, or showcasing fabric. The scene features multiple figures spread across the foreground and background. The figures are drawn in a sketch-like style, capturing motion and interaction with their environment. They are engaged in daily life or labor activities, possibly in an outdoor or communal setting. The use of line in the drawing emphasizes the curves and fluidity of the human form and fabric. The atmosphere is lively, possibly from a mythological or historical context.

artworks.title: The Fall of Phaeton
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink over red chalk with brown and gray wash on laid paper
artworks.dimensions:
Overall (approximate): 40.7 x 33 cm (16 x 13 in.)
support: 50.6 x 43.4 cm (19 15/16 x 17 1/16 in.)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a mythological scene involving a chariot pulled by horses. The drawing depicts two powerful horses pulling a chariot at high speed through the sky. The chariot is being driven energetically. Beneath, there are figures in expressive poses looking up towards the chariot. The image is created using ink and wash, giving a dynamic and fluid sense with lines suggesting motion and loose, expressive forms. The figures are drawn in a classical style with an emphasis on motion and emotion.

artworks.title: The Defeat of Sennacherib
artworks.artist: Pieter Claesz Soutman and Sir Peter Paul Rubens
artworks.medium: black chalk and pen and black ink with gray wash on laid paper
artworks.dimensions:
Overall (approximate): 35.2 x 45.4 cm (13 7/8 x 17 7/8 in.)
support: 35.9 x 46.5 cm (14 1/8 x 18 5/16 in.)
artworks.description: This is a drawing featuring horses and figures in motion. The composition includes horses in dynamic poses, rearing and galloping, with detailed musculature and flowing manes. There are figures depicted alongside the horses, enhancing the sense of motion. The scene conveys action and drama, with intricate linework showcasing tension and movement.

artworks.title: Pleasures of Brittany (Joies de Bretagne)
artworks.description: The image shows two women walking arm in arm, both in traditional attire. One woman is facing away with a slight profile, while the other is seen from the side. Their faces are stylized and simplistic with covered hair. They wear long dresses with aprons and collars, and one has a striped apron. Haystacks and greenery surround them. Faint figures are in the background, as well as a spire-like structure. A dog is seen near the haystack, with simple lines suggesting a landscape.

artworks.title: Donkey in a Field (L'Ane au pre)
artworks.description: The image shows various figures and animals in a landscape scene. A donkey with bridles is closest to the viewer, with other figures and animals depicted further away. A line of trees and bushes marks the horizon. The artwork features delicate and meticulous line work, creating texture and depth. The color palette is mostly sepia, giving a vintage quality to the image. Birds are seen flying in the sky above.

artworks.title: Time, Apollo, and the Seasons (Le Temps, Apollon et les Saisons)
artworks.description: The image shows a wide landscape with distant hills, a forested area, ruins with columns and arches, foliage, and figures in classical attire dancing. There is a winged figure nearby. The brushstrokes are detailed and the color palette is monochromatic with shades of brown and sepia.

artworks.title: The Father's Leave-Taking
artworks.dimensions:
plate: 19 x 25.4 cm (7 1/2 x 10 in.)
sheet: 28.7 x 44 cm (11 5/16 x 17 5/16 in.)
overall (mat size): 40.6 x 55.9 cm (16 x 22 in.)
artworks.description: The image shows a woman and a child sitting on the floor in an indoor setting. The woman is holding the child on her lap. The woman wears a long dress and has long hair. The child has light, wavy hair and wears a simple outfit. In the background, there are columns and a doorway leading to a room with a table and various objects. The image is monochromatic and rendered in a sketch-like style.

artworks.title: Temple of the Sibyl, Tivoli
artworks.description: The image shows a rocky landscape with waterfalls viewed from above. A circular structure resembling a temple or rotunda is perched on a cliff to the upper left, with distinct columns. Clouds mark the high horizon, while the rocky landscape with dense foliage fills the lower part of the image. Meticulous etching lines create texture and depth, especially in the foliage and water. The color palette is monochromatic with shades of brown and beige. The scene conveys vastness, natural grandeur, and includes a temple as a focal point.

artworks.title: Balthasar Bathory de Somlyo
artworks.description: The image shows a man standing with one hand on his hip and the other holding a sword. He has a mustache and short hair, wearing elaborate, period-specific clothing with a ruffled collar and stockings. The background includes a landscape with hills, figures, and horses, and a detailed sky.

artworks.title: Bust of an Old Woman Wearing a Head Scarf
artworks.medium: black chalk and colored chalks on laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows an older woman's upper body, up to the chest. She faces forward with her head turned slightly to the right. The woman has fine wrinkles on her face, a smiling expression, slightly squinted eyes, and partially visible hair. She wears a headscarf over her shoulders, and layered attire with a reddish outer garment and grey inner garment. The background is a plain, textured surface without any accessories or objects.

artworks.title: Saint Francis Consoled by the Musical Angel
artworks.artist: Attributed to Francesco Carracci after Agostino Carracci
artworks.description: The image depicts a man seated in a resting position. His body leans slightly forward with his head resting on his right hand, which holds a quill pen. His elbow is supported by a large, open book. His eyes are closed. He has a beard, mustache, and curly hair on his head. He wears long robes. His left hand holds a rosary with a cross, and a skull is beside him. An angelic figure with large wings hovers in the background, holding a palm branch. The background features mountains, trees, and a cloudy sky.
